Financial_Insti.name: PhilHealth
Financial_Insti.description: PhilHealth is the Philippines' government-owned health insurer, providing universal health coverage through a social insurance program. It pools funds from member contributions to subsidize medical costs, making healthcare affordable for hospitalizations and preventive care.
Financial_Insti.location: Valgosons Building, Bolton Extension, Poblacion, Davao City

programs.program_name: PhilHealth YAKAP: Yaman ng Kalusugan Program
programs.eligibility: Government and Private Employees; Kasambahay; Indigents; Persons with Disability; Self-Earning Individuals or Professional Practitioners; Lifetime Members; Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps); Infants and Children under 21 years old; Overseas Filipino Workers; Solo Parent; Senior Citizens
programs.program_description: Government program that helps Filipinos take care of their health and prevent illness. YAKAP Clinics watch over members' health, find illness early, and give the right medicines so the illness does not get worse and hospital stays are avoided.

benefits.benefit_name: Primary Care Checkup (free)

Selected laboratory tests based on risk, age and health assessment: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Platelet Count, Lipid Profile, Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT), Hemoglobin Test (HbA1c), Creatinine, Chest X-Ray, Sputum Microscopy, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Urinalysis, Pap Smear, Fecalysis, Fecal Occult Blood Test (FOBT), Upper Abdomen & Pelvic Ultrasound
Medicines under PhilHealth GAMOT
Breast cancer screening: Breast Ultrasound & Mammogram
Liver cancer screening: Alpha Fetoprotein Test & Liver Ultrasound
Colorectal cancer screening: Fecal Immunochemical Test, Fecal Occult Blood Test & Colonoscopy
Lung cancer screening: Low-dose Chest CT Scan

requirements.requirement_description: PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) with updated membership

procedure.instruction: Register: make sure you have a PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) and your membership is updated.
Choose a YAKAP Clinic using the eGovPH Super App, the PhilHealth Member Portal, or the nearest PhilHealth office.
Have your First Patient Encounter (FPE): medical history, health screening and health education.
Sign the form agreeing that your chosen YAKAP Clinic will keep caring for you.
Keep seeing your YAKAP doctor for prescriptions, referrals for laboratory and/or cancer screening tests when needed, and follow-up checkups.

programs.program_name: Z Benefits: Breast Cancer (cStage 0 to IV)
programs.eligibility: PhilHealth members and their qualified dependents who are eligible to avail of PhilHealth benefits at the time of pre-authorization approval, and who meet the selection criteria: breast cancer clinical stage requiring treatments covered under the Z Benefits (Stage 0 Ductal Carcinoma in Situ (DCIS), Stage I, Stage II, Stage III or Stage IV), with management involving any or all of: Surgery; Chemotherapy (neo/adjuvant): patient has not initiated any chemotherapy treatment from any HF; Targeted therapy; Hormonotherapy; Surveillance. Diagnostic tests are covered when all of these are met: Positive (+) breast mass AND/OR palpable axillary lymph node; BI-RADS category 4 to 5 result of either mammogram or ultrasound; and Biopsy result of confirmed malignant breast cancer or ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS).
programs.program_description: PhilHealth's Z Benefit package for breast cancer, up to P1.4 million (effective March 30, 2024). It covers diagnostic tests, surgery, hormonotherapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy and surveillance after surgery, at Z Benefits contracted health facilities. Up to five (5) days are deducted from the 45-day annual benefit limit.

benefits.benefit_name: Up to P1.4 million
Diagnostic tests and prognostication: Php 1,000 to Php 10,000.00
Surgical procedures (partial mastectomy to modified radical mastectomy): Php 30,000 – Php 140,000.00
Hormonotherapy: Php 2,700 or Php 18,000
Cytotoxic chemotherapy: Php 43,000 to Php 185,010
Targeted therapy: Php 333,336 for 18 maximum cycles
Surveillance: Php 5,000 (basic) and Php 9,000 (specific)
No co-payment for patients admitted in basic or ward-type accommodation

procedure.instruction: Regardless of the type of cancer, bring your PhilHealth ID to the hospital's Z Benefits coordinator for the list of requirements and further steps.

programs.program_name: Z Benefits: Acute Lymphocytic / Lymphoblastic Leukemia (standard risk)
programs.eligibility: PhilHealth members and their qualified dependents, eligible upon application for pre-authorization (patients not yet registered in PhilHealth must complete member registration first), with a newly diagnosed case (a first-time diagnosis, not previously treated for the same condition under this Z Benefit package), who meet the selection criteria: Age 1 to less than 10 years old and 364 days; White blood cell count ‹50,000/mcL; No CNS leukemia at diagnosis; There should be no testicular involvement of male patient at diagnosis; WHO Classification: B or T lymphoblastic leukemia immunophenotype (mature B-cell ALL or Burkitt leukemia are excluded). The membership category upon approval of the pre-authorization applies for the three years of the package.
programs.program_description: PhilHealth's Z Benefit package for children with standard-risk acute lymphoblastic leukemia: five hundred thousand pesos (Php 500,000) for the complete course of treatment for three (3) years, paid to the contracted health facility in three tranches. Pre-authorization must be submitted before the end of the induction phase.

benefits.benefit_name: Php 500,000 for the complete course of treatment for three (3) years
Tranche 1: Php 300,000 (after the 1st induction phase)
Tranche 2: Php 125,000 (after the 3rd maintenance cycle)
Tranche 3: Php 75,000 (after the 7th maintenance cycle)

procedure.instruction: Regardless of the type of cancer, bring your PhilHealth ID to the hospital's Z Benefits coordinator for the list of requirements and further steps.

programs.program_name: Z Benefits: Prostate Cancer (low to intermediate risk)
programs.eligibility: PhilHealth members and their qualified dependents, eligible upon application for pre-authorization (patients not yet registered in PhilHealth must complete member registration first), with a newly diagnosed case (a first-time diagnosis, not previously treated for the same condition under this Z Benefit package), who meet the selection criteria: Male patients age up to 70 years old; Clinical stage (T1a-T2c), PSA level 10 to 20 ng/ml, Tumor Grade (Gleason's score of 2-7) - Low risk: T1-T2a and Gleason score 2-6, and PSA ‹10 ng/ml - Intermediate risk: T2b to T2c, Gleason score of 7, and PSA 10-20 ng/ml; Localized prostate cancer; No uncontrolled co-morbid conditions.
programs.program_description: PhilHealth's Z Benefit package for localized low- to intermediate-risk prostate cancer, at Z Benefits contracted health facilities.

procedure.instruction: Regardless of the type of cancer, bring your PhilHealth ID to the hospital's Z Benefits coordinator for the list of requirements and further steps.

programs.eligibility: PhilHealth members and their qualified dependents, eligible upon application for pre-authorization (patients not yet registered in PhilHealth must complete member registration first), with a newly diagnosed case (a first-time diagnosis, not previously treated for the same condition under this Z Benefit package), who meet the selection criteria: No previous chemotherapy; No previous radiotherapy; No uncontrolled co-morbid conditions.
programs.program_description: PhilHealth's Z Benefit package for cervical cancer treatment (chemoradiation with brachytherapy, or primary surgery for early stages), at Z Benefits contracted health facilities.

benefits.benefit_name: Chemoradiation with Cobalt and Brachytherapy (low dose) or Primary surgery for Stage IA1, IA2 - IIA1: P120,000
Chemoradiation with Linear Accelerator and Brachytherapy (high dose): P175,000

procedure.instruction: Regardless of the type of cancer, bring your PhilHealth ID to the hospital's Z Benefits coordinator for the list of requirements and further steps.

programs.eligibility: PhilHealth members and their qualified dependents who are eligible to avail of PhilHealth benefits at the time of pre-authorization approval, with colon or rectal cancer stage I to III, who meet the selection criteria: Normal or with mild systemic disease (ASA I or II); Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction, OR restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out work of a light or sedentary nature, e.g light house work, office work, OR ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities. Up and about more than 50% of working hours. Services needed after progression to stage IV are not covered.
programs.program_description: PhilHealth's Z Benefit package for colon and rectal cancer. The amount depends on the cancer, its stage and risk. Available at Z Benefits contracted health facilities. Up to five (5) days are deducted from the 45-day annual benefit limit.

benefits.benefit_name: Colon Cancer, Stage I to II (Low Risk): Php 150,000
Colon Cancer, Stage II to III (High Risk): Php 300,000
Rectal Cancer, Stage I to II (Low Risk): Php 150,000
Rectal Cancer, Pre-operative Stage I, with Post-Operative Stage II to III: Php 400,000
Rectal Cancer, Stage II to III: Php 400,000

procedure.instruction: Regardless of the type of cancer, bring your PhilHealth ID to the hospital's Z Benefits coordinator for the list of requirements and further steps.

Financial_Insti.name: Social Security System (SSS)
Financial_Insti.description: The SSS provides social security protection to workers in the private, professional, and informal sectors. It offers replacement income for contingencies like sickness, maternity, disability, retirement, and death.
Financial_Insti.location: SSS Building, J.P. Laurel Avenue, Bajada, Davao City

programs.eligibility: Members with at least 36 monthly contributions
programs.program_description: A cash loan designed to meet the member's short-term credit needs.

benefits.benefit_name: Cash assistance equivalent to one or two months salary

requirements.requirement_description: Digitized SSS ID or UMID Card.

procedure.instruction: Log in to your My.SSS account.
Go to 'Loans' and select 'Apply for Salary Loan'.
Submit and wait for employer certification.

Financial_Insti.name: Government Service Insurance System (GSIS)
Financial_Insti.description: GSIS manages the social insurance program for government employees in the Philippines. It provides life insurance, retirement, and disability benefits to those in public service.

programs.program_description: Consolidates all existing loans into one with lower interest and longer terms.

benefits.benefit_name: Lower interest rate (6% per annum)
Waived surcharges on previous loans

requirements.requirement_description: Duly accomplished application form and GSIS eCard.

procedure.instruction: Apply through the GSIS Touch mobile app or GW@PS kiosk.
Wait for Agency Authorized Officer (AAO) approval.
Loan proceeds are credited to the eCard/UMID account.

Financial_Insti.name: Pag-IBIG Fund (HDMF)
Financial_Insti.description: The Home Development Mutual Fund, known as Pag-IBIG, is a national savings program and affordable shelter financing for Filipino workers.
Financial_Insti.location: Pryce Tower, J.P. Laurel Ave, Bajada, Davao City

programs.program_description: Financing for house purchase, construction, or home improvement.

benefits.benefit_name: Low interest rates
Payment terms up to 30 years

requirements.requirement_description: Income documents (ITR or Payslip) and TCT/CCT of the property.

procedure.instruction: Attend the Housing Loan Counseling (online or onsite).
Submit the Housing Loan Application (HLA) with requirements.
Receive the Notice of Approval (NOA) and sign loan documents.
